rca of the issue: Backend 502s from external URL were caused by MongoDB sensor_readings collection having 403,373 records with only default _id index. Every /api/sensors/latest call performs 27 sort-by-timestamp queries filtered on instrument_id — without indexes these did full collection scans and exceeded ingress timeout (>30s). Fixed by creating compound index (instrument_id ASC, timestamp DESC). Endpoints now respond in <1s.
